sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the instruction-tuned nominal 72B Qwen model; documents text, image and video inputs, text generation, visual reasoning, document understanding and tool-directed visual agents. Its Processing Long Texts section describes 32768 and optional YaRN extrapolation, although the shipped model config specifies 128000.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL release announcement
sources.evidence: January 26, 2025 announcement explicitly releases Qwen2.5-VL and names Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct. The subsequent Hugging Face repository creation date is January 27, not the announcement date.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint model configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration: dense 80-layer language decoder, 8192 hidden dimension, 64 attention heads/8 KV heads, and 32-layer vision transformer. max_position_embeddings is 128000.

sources.title: Qwen License Agreement
sources.evidence: Custom Qwen license, including commercial permission condition above 100 million monthly active users. Its September 2024 license date is not this model release date.

sources.title: Checkpoint index and referenced Safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Independently read only the first 65536 bytes of each of the 38 referenced shards. All 1353 tensor shapes total 73410777344 BF16 parameters: 72706203648 language-model parameters and 704573696 visual-encoder/merger parameters. This agrees with index total_size 146821554688 bytes divided by two.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Tokenizer model_max_length is 131072; this controls tokenization defaults, not model positional capacity. Template handles image/video/text and has no separate thinking-mode switch; tool-call tokens are present.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
sources.evidence: Section 2.1 and Table 1 describe the 72B variant as Qwen2.5 language decoder, vision transformer and MLP merger; no expert routing. General reasoning and tool-use abilities are described, without defining a separate reasoning-mode capability. Section 2.2.2 gives 32768 as final-stage pretraining sequence length.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Defines max_position_embeddings as the model maximum sequence length; checkpoint configuration overrides the class default. Legacy mrope selects the default RoPE computation, not automatic YaRN scaling.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL rotary embedding implementation
sources.evidence: Qwen2_5_VLRotaryEmbedding initializes its original_max_seq_len and max_seq_len_cached from model config.max_position_embeddings, not tokenizer.model_max_length. Position frequencies are computed from supplied position IDs.

sources.title: Transformers tokenizer truncation and padding documentation
sources.evidence: Tokenizer maximum length supplies padding/truncation defaults. Tokenization can emit longer sequences when truncation is disabled; this setting does not alter model positional configuration.

name.note: Display spelling represents the exact official Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct identifier.

family.note: Qwen2.5-VL belongs to the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official announcement explicitly names this variant; distinguish repository creation the next day.

license.note: Custom Qwen License Agreement; not Apache-2.0.

parameters_b.note: Exact full checkpoint tensor count in decimal billions, including visual encoder and merger. 72B is the nominal variant label, not the exact multimodal total.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count. Do not equate total with active: visual processing and language decoding use different components.

architecture.note: Dense decoder plus ViT and MLP merger, corroborated by tensor inventory; no MoE expert/router tensors.

context_window.note: 128000 is the shipped checkpoint configured maximum (max_position_embeddings), used by the model implementation; tokenizer model_max_length=131072 only supplies preprocessing defaults and does not supersede it. This is configured context, not an independently tested quality limit. The card still describes 32768 and optional YaRN, while the report gives 32768 training sequences; those remain caveats about long-text extrapolation rather than grounds to replace the explicit current model setting.

modalities.note: Official examples explicitly support video as well as image and text.

reasoning.note: General visual reasoning is documented, but that does not establish a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode. Neither a definitive true nor false mode flag was verified.

tool_call.note: Developer explicitly describes dynamic tool use; exact tokenizer includes tool-call tokens. Serving integration may require its own tool prompt/template.

description.value: Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: Supported capability summary, without an unsupported superiority claim.

patch.notes: 72B is the nominal label; the complete BF16 checkpoint has 73.410777344B parameters, including 0.704573696B in the visual encoder and merger. Active parameters are not separately defined. Context 128000 follows the shipped model positional configuration; tokenizer length 131072 is a preprocessing setting. The card describes 32768 and optional YaRN, and the report documents 32768 training sequences, so configured context does not establish long-text quality. A dedicated reasoning-mode boolean remains unverified.

summary: Verified total size 73.410777344B versus nominal 72B; added dense architecture, Qwen license and video input. Context corrected to the shipped model configuration value 128000, distinguishing tokenizer defaults and 32768 training/card guidance. Release and description confirmed; active size undisclosed and dedicated reasoning mode unverified.
